_comment: `import()` and `import.defer()` of one JSON module, in both orders. A JSON module has no interop wrapper (`unwrap_json_module`). The chunks of `first.json` and `second.json` also export the deferred namespace objects, so `import()` reads the namespace object from the chunk. `local.json` is in the chunk of the importer. The `cjs` variant loads the chunks with `require()`. The `strict` variant gives each JSON module an execution-order wrapper, and no code evaluates `local.json` before `import()`. So `import()` calls `init_x()`.
